resources.string: Sending again works one message at a time, in each chat. Hold the button to confirm.
Delete this message together with the attachment?
A chat can be in several folders. Deleting a folder leaves the messages intact.
The chats stay where they are — only the view disappears.
Chats are encrypted, but it is not confirmed that %1$s is on the other end.
The key of %1$s goes to another person, who can then write directly. This cannot be undone.
Measures mesh speed to a contact
About 30 MB of test data goes over the mesh. Data and battery are spent on both sides.
Messages are dropped before decryption, and the contact is removed from the list.
The contact and the conversation history will be removed from this device.
The conversation will be deleted from this device, including messages not yet sent. The other person keeps their copy.
Packets are dropped before decryption: CPU and battery are not spent, data is. Counted since the app started.
Data stops being spent at once. Messages do not arrive until back online.
The stream is cut, the connection stays. Selected contacts receive the new address.
Identity does not change: name, key, history and groups stay. Only the network address changes.
Unselected contacts keep the old address and lose contact with this phone.
Selected contacts get a signed notice
Cannot be undone: the old address is released at once.
Coming up under the new address
Address not changed: the previous one stays.
Address not changed. No connection — Network → Go online.
A stream on the new address means one of the notified contacts knows it.
Cut off the stream from whoever knows the old one

Connections dropped, no data is being spent. Messages will not arrive.
Not done — your identity rests on 24 words
Tap the avatar to change it
Ask for biometrics or the device PIN when you come back
Set a screen lock in the phone settings first
Messages on this phone are locked with a password. Until it is entered, messages are not received.
The system may reset the device key; the messages then will not open, only a data backup file brings them back.
The password cannot be recovered. Messages on this phone stay locked.
Same key; messages and the network address come back from a data backup file
Locked data is set aside. Encryption after restoring: “device key”.
Opens by itself. A memory dump is useless; on an unlocked phone only the app lock protects it.
Asked at every start; messages are not received until it is entered. Does not depend on the device key.
Both this phone and the password are needed.
A forgotten password cannot be recovered: the 24 words bring back the identity, a data backup file — the messages.
The identity is not part of the backup: the 24 words restore it.
Large files do not fit into the archive, but they can be downloaded from the sender again — they are addressed by content.

Group messages are included, keys are not: the archive restores what to read, not what to decrypt with. A restored group state would be stale and would break the group for everyone, so the group opens read-only until you are invited again.
The file will leave the phone — to a cloud, a card, another computer. This device\'s key is not available there, so the archive is locked with a password and opens anywhere.
A forgotten password cannot be recovered: the 24 words will not open such a backup either.
Keep this screen open. Checking the password takes about a second — deliberately: it costs the same to anyone trying to guess it.
Nothing is deleted: whatever arrived after the backup stays. Restoring the same file twice adds nothing.
The key is the same: for contacts this is the same identity.
From a data backup file: contacts, messages, notes
Without a backup file, contacts and chats start from scratch. Group membership is not transferred.
The file is not a data backup
This backup is additionally protected by a password.
“Verified” marks are not part of the backup: contacts are verified again after restoring. Groups are readable; writing to them needs a new invitation.
Opens on a phone with this identity.
Without the password the file does not open even with the 24 words.
A forgotten password cannot be recovered: such a backup does not open even with the 24 words.
Couldn\'t write the file to the chosen place.
Groups need to be restored by hand
Writing to groups needs a new invitation from members. Group history stays visible.
“Verified” marks are not restored: contacts are verified again after restoring.
Messages from others can only be removed on your side — rewriting someone else\'s history is not possible.
Already deleted for everyone. The line can be removed on this device only.
Archive from a backup · not a group member
The recipient sees “forwarded” but not from whom. The author key is not sent at all.
“For everyone” asks the others to delete them too. Messages already read or saved can’t be recalled.
